overlay_search.result: No additional direct reference to 0x007DA060/0x007DA064 occurs inside the horse Paint routine 0x004269C0-0x00426A74; the routine draws Frame 850 base and five child controls in fixed order. The window-manager paint dispatcher (0x00428252 calls horse Paint 0x004269C0 for the window at winmgr+0x52118) is a plain per-window switch with no state-dependent overlay on the horse frame.
overlay_search.interpretation: Closed: no state-dependent overlay is drawn on the horse window itself. The mount-state block is additionally consumed by a main-game-window HUD draw at 0x0044B666 (reads word[0x007DA063] and passes it into draw call 0x45FD50 with this=0x008AB7A8) - a HUD/dock icon on the main window, not a horse-window overlay (see closed_notes).

closed_notes.conclusion: 0x007DA060 is byte 0 of a 5-byte mount-state block stored in the session object 0x00777698 at offset +0x629C8 (0x777698+0x629C8 == 0x7DA060). The block layout is byte0 state (0x007DA060), word (0x007DA061-62), word/byte (0x007DA063-64). The ONLY static writer of the block is session virtual 0x0040F420 (vtable slot at 0x00476508; wrapper 0x0040FED0 at 0x004765CC): lea eax,[esi+0x629C8] at 0x0040F43A, mov dword[ecx],edx + mov byte[ecx+4],dl at 0x0040F442/0x0040F448 with this=0x777698 at every call site (0x41F5DB/0x41F680). The state byte is clamped to 0..3 by cmp byte[eax],4; jb; mov byte[eax],0 at 0x0040F46D-0x0040F472 - a 2-bit enum, not a bitmask. Click dispatch 0x00426A80 uses it as a gate: ==0 allows the Frame 860/861 button (+0x108) to dispatch @上马; !=0 allows Frame 862/863 (+0x1BC) to dispatch @遛马. The packet path (dispatcher 0x0041F1CF, case 0x267 at 0x41F597 / case 0x26B at 0x41F666) reads the block and re-sends it via 0x40F420 (echo to server); case 0x267 also writes the two word fields from packet input. The state byte additionally selects a per-state animation table entry at 0x5600FC with stride 324 (lea eax,[eax+eax*8]; lea edx,[eax+eax*8]; lea eax,[edx*4+0x5600FC] at 0x40F583-0x40F590 and 0x40F5A8-0x40F5B9) stored at session +0x62A10/+0x62A14 - the mounted appearance data, outside the window. Overlay question: NO overlay exists on the horse window itself (paint 0x4269C0 has no mount-block reference; window-manager paint dispatch at 0x428252 adds none). A state-dependent HUD draw does exist OUTSIDE the horse Paint routine, on the main game window: main-window paint segment 0x44B560-0x44B6AF reads word[0x007DA063] at 0x0044B666 and passes it as an argument to draw call 0x0045FD50 with this=0x008AB7A8 (main game window), gated by byte[0x777723] (1..10) and icon index byte[0x777720] - i.e. a mount-state-dependent HUD/dock icon on the main window, not a horse-window overlay. This closes the pending item.
